guards: Secret(vault_key='minio_root_user', message='MinIO root username', kind='text', default='admin', generate=False)
Secret(vault_key='minio_root_password', message='MinIO root password', kind='password', default=None, generate=True)
quadlet:
[Unit]
Description=MinIO object storage server

[Container]
Image=quay.io/minio/minio:latest
Volume=/srv/minio/data:/data:Z
Environment=MINIO_ROOT_USER=<vault:minio_root_user>
Environment=MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD=<vault:minio_root_password>
Exec=server /data --console-address ":9001"
PublishPort=9000:9000
PublishPort=9001:9001

[Service]
Restart=always

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
